AREAS OF EXPERTISE
**AREAS OF EXPERTISE**

• Full Stack Development, Python Development, Healthcare Application Development, Virtual Patient Rooms
• AI/LLM Application Development, AI Agents, AI-Assisted Development, Generative AI Integration
• API Development, EHR Integration, HL7/FHIR Interoperability, Real-Time Integrations
• AI Architecture, LLM Workflows, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Based Applications
• HIPAA Compliance, Secure Authentication, Microservices, Cloud Solutions
• Dashboard Development, Data Analytics, Reporting, Agile Delivery

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCIES
**TECHNICAL PROFICIENCIES**

• **Languages & Frameworks:** Python, Django, Flask, FastAPI, Node.js, Express.js, Angular, React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript

• **AI & Generative AI:** LLM Integration, Generative AI, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Patterns, LLM Workflows, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI APIs, AI-Assisted Development Tools

• **Databases:** SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, DynamoDB, Azure SQL

• **APIs & Integrations:** RESTful APIs, Zoom API, Cerner API, Meditech API, Webhooks, FHIR, HL7, API Orchestration, LLM/AI APIs

• **Cloud Platforms:** AWS (EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS), Azure (App Service, Functions, Data Factory, Logic Apps, Azure OpenAI), GCP (App Engine, Cloud SQL, Dataflow)

• **Containerization & Orchestration:** Docker, Kubernetes (EKS)

• **Authentication & Security:** OAuth2.0, JWT, Azure AD/Entra ID, IAM, HIPAA-Compliant Security Practices

• **Dashboards & Reporting:** Python Dash, Power BI, Tableau, Chart.js

• **Messaging & Streaming:** Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, WebSockets

• **Automation & DevOps:** Jenkins, Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Git, CI/CD Pipelines

• **Testing & API Tools:** PyTest, Selenium, Locust, Swagger, OpenAPI

• **Data & ML:** Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, MLflow, SageMaker, spaCy

EDUCATION
Gandhi Institute of Technology
and Management
Bachelor of Computer Science Engineering 
PROFILE
**PROFILE**

Results-driven Senior Python Full Stack Developer with 10+ years of experience designing and building scalable, secure, cloud-native applications across healthcare, financial services, and enterprise environments. Strong expertise in Python, FastAPI, Django, React, REST APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and enterprise integrations, with extensive experience developing HIPAA-compliant healthcare solutions and real-time Virtual Patient Room platforms. Experienced in integrating modern AI/LLM capabilities into enterprise applications, including LLM-powered workflows, AI agents, prompt-driven services, retrieval-based patterns, and AI-assisted developer productivity tools. Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable application and AI architectures, integrate third-party and cloud AI services, and rapidly adapt emerging AI technologies to existing enterprise platforms.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Raining Virtue | Full Stack Developer | 2025 - 2026
• Designed and developed a Virtual Patient Room platform integrating 
Meditech clinical scheduling with Zoom video visits, enabling providers 
to manage virtual appointments and patients to securely join 
scheduled sessions.


• Developed scalable backend APIs and microservices using Python, 
FastAPI, SQL Server, and REST to create and manage Zoom meetings, 
synchronize appointment data, and power provider and patient 
dashboards.
• Built React-based provider and patient dashboards with calendar 
views, resource-group filtering, appointment status tracking, ad-hoc 
meeting creation, host joining, and patient verification workflows.
• Implemented automated Node.js scheduling jobs to create and 
synchronize Zoom meetings while handling cancelled, no-show, 
rescheduled, and non-Zoom appointments between Meditech and the 
VPR Info DB.
• Developed a FastAPI-based Zoom webhook consumer to process 
meeting lifecycle events, validate webhook requests, update real-time 
meeting statuses, and maintain synchronization with the SQL Server 
Info DB.
• Implemented secure authentication and authorization using Entra 
SSO, oauth2-proxy, service JWTs, and Meditech SAMB/SBHO facilitybased access controls while protecting sensitive patient and meeting 
information.
• Containerized and deployed independently scalable backend, 
frontend, scheduler, and webhook services using Docker, nginx, 
Gunicorn/Uvicorn, and GitHub Actions, with structured logging, health 
checks, error handling, and performance optimizations for reliable 
production operations.
• Analyzed post-migration service performance and reported a 62.7% 
reduction in dropped-call incidents, decreasing reported incidents 
from 450 with Vonage to 168 with Zoom, demonstrating improved 
reliability and stability for patient–provider virtual visits
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE (CONTINUED)
Ascension Health | Lead Software Developer | 2023 – 2025 
• Designed and deployed HIPAA-compliant Virtual Patient Rooms by replicating Cerner workflows and extending them with Zoom API 
integrations, OAuth2.0/JWT authentication, and secure SQL Server storage for provider–patient links.
• Developed scalable dashboards and microservices (Python, Node.js, React, FastAPI) to support patient intake, scheduling, and 
real-time appointment link management across multiple hospital units.
• Integrated Azure OpenAI and LLM-based capabilities into backend workflows to support intelligent information processing, summarization, and developer-facing automation while maintaining secure API boundaries and enterprise application controls.

• Designed AI-assisted service patterns using Python/FastAPI and LangChain/LangGraph concepts to orchestrate LLM interactions, structured prompts, contextual data retrieval, and multi-step processing within existing microservice architectures.

• Leveraged modern AI-assisted developer productivity tools for code generation, debugging, API documentation, test creation, refactoring, and technical analysis, accelerating development while maintaining established engineering, security, and code-review practices.
• Evaluated and integrated Generative AI and LLM capabilities into healthcare application workflows, designing secure service architectures for contextual data processing while maintaining HIPAA and enterprise security requirements.

• Developed proof-of-concept AI agent and LLM workflows using Python, Azure OpenAI, and LangChain to orchestrate API calls, retrieve application context, and generate structured responses for internal workflow automation.

• Designed scalable AI integration patterns using REST APIs, microservices, event-driven processing, and cloud services, enabling LLM capabilities to be introduced into existing healthcare applications without disrupting core transactional workflows.

• Integrated Zoom API webhooks and automation pipelines (Azure Logic Apps, Kafka, Redis) to manage meeting lifecycles, 
notifications, and patient redirection into scheduled sessions.
• Built interoperability with EHR systems by mapping HL7/FHIR data, integrating Cerner and Meditech APIs, and synchronizing 
encounter data to ensure accurate routing of patient–provider video visits.
• Ensured compliance, reliability, and scalability through containerized deployments (Kubernetes/EKS), IAM/audit reviews, structured 
logging (Splunk), and automated error-handling for session continuity.
Texas Capital | Sr. Software Engineer | 2021 – 2023 
• Developed secure, API-driven dashboards (Python, Node.js, Angular, React) with OAuth2.0, JWT, and IAM policies to support 
compliance workflows and role-based access.
• Integrated LLM-powered capabilities into enterprise application workflows using Python and cloud AI services, focusing on structured prompts, API orchestration, contextual data processing, and secure handling of business information.

• Applied AI-assisted development tools throughout the software lifecycle for code analysis, unit-test generation, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and productivity improvements across Python and React-based applications.

• Designed and optimized database schemas (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, GCP Cloud SQL) with tuned queries, caching (Redis), and 
structured storage for secure link and workflow management.
• Built scalable, cloud-based solutions by migrating dashboards to GCP App Engine, implementing reusable RESTful services, and 
delivering automated CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins.
• Created real-time reporting and monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Power BI) for compliance and audit teams, integrating highvolume transaction data and risk metrics.
• Ensured reliability and performance with automated pipelines, structured testing (PyTest, Locust), and reverse-engineered legacy 
workflows into modern, modular services.
DesIDEA Software Technologies | Python Full Stack Developer | 2018 – 2021 
• Developed secure, high-volume backend APIs (Python, Flask, REST) with JWT and Azure AD authentication, supporting 10K+ daily 
client transactions.
• Engineered scalable ETL and data workflows (Azure Data Factory, Logic Apps, serverless functions) to automate ingestion, 
transformation, and real-time processing of healthcare and financial datasets, improving latency by 40% and reducing manual work 
by 90%.
• Designed and optimized relational data models (PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Azure SQL) to ensure data integrity, normalized 
schemas, and accurate reporting for compliance systems.
• Built interactive reporting dashboards (Power BI) with drill-downs and KPIs, cutting monthly reporting prep time by 50% and enabling 
leaders to analyze billing and transaction trends.
• Improved system reliability and delivery by refactoring legacy modules, implementing structured logging/monitoring (Azure Monitor, 
App Insights), and automating CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, doubling release frequency.
Bizionic Technology | Software Developer | 2014 – 2018 
• Developed and optimized backend services (Python, Django, Oracle SQL, stored procedures) to improve application performance 
and reduce server errors.
• Built responsive, interactive front-end components (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX) that increased client portal engagement 
by 15%.
• Integrated third-party systems via SOAP web services and XML data feeds, ensuring interoperability with legacy and modern 
platforms.
• Contributed to cross-functional Agile teams, delivering features in sprints, writing unit tests (PyTest), and reducing post-release 
defects by 20%.
• Maintained collaborative codebases using Git and contributed to Java-based scheduling modules, gaining experience with multithreaded service design
